	<ResortReportHeadline>Improving weather and the Drift scheduled to spin!</ResortReportHeadline>
	<ResortReport><p>Anything could happen this morning. Right now, there's an alpenglow out to the east with cloud moving in from the west and the forecast is calling for a cloudy day with the chance of a snow shower. &nbsp;</p><p>At 6am it's -2 degrees which was also the overnight low as we head for a top of +2 degrees. The wind has swung around and is currently moderate from the WSW.</p><p>With yesterday's warming followed by a cooling the 4cm of fresh snow that fell yesterday has definitely firmed up overnight. The groomers will be the go first up this morning and it feels like there's enough texture to get your edges in. Off piste will likely be very challenging with some areas having formed a crust so be sure to feel it out and perhaps wait for any softening to occur.</p><p>In other news, pending weather and final checks the Drift T-Bar is scheduled to spin at some stage today. Keep an eye on the App and the lift report for all the latest updates.</p><p>Have a great day out there. Cheers, Burner.</p></ResortReport>

It will probably be skiing and riding ok in some areas but may be challenging in others.  Take care out there.  </Backcountry>
